content: Recoverable HST/GST means the business paid tax on a purchase and can claim it back as an Input Tax Credit (ITC) on your return. Use Recoverable for most business expenses where HST was charged on the invoice.
Collected HST/GST means tax the business charges to customers on sales. This is tax you remit to CRA, not tax you paid on purchases.
Included means the listed price already contains HST/GST. The system treats the tax as embedded in the amount rather than added on top.
Exempt means no HST/GST applies to that category or transaction. Use for truly non-taxable items per Canadian rules.
The Accounting Queue is where emailed or uploaded invoices land as drafts. Review extracted amounts, match vendors, assign categories with correct HST treatment, then approve to post the expense.

Expense categories in Tavari Accounting control how expenses are grouped and what default HST treatment applies. Set categories under Sidebar → Tavari Accounting → Categories. When staff ask which category to use, recommend from this business's actual category list and give one clear pick.

Classify expenses using this business's category list. Quick rules: COGS / COGS-Bar / COGS-Kitchen / Concession = inventory or resale goods you buy to sell (food, liquor, balloons)—not contractor/host fees. Advertising / Marketing = spend whose main purpose is attracting customers. Professional Fees / Professional / Corporate Fees = contracted services (trivia host, DJ, bookkeeping, legal, consultants). Repair & Maintenance = fixing/maintaining premises or equipment. Wages and Salaries = payroll to employees, not vendor invoices. When unsure between Marketing and Professional Fees for a guest entertainment contractor, prefer Professional Fees; mention Marketing only if the spend is clearly promotional media/ads. Prefer Recoverable HST when the invoice charged HST. Give a direct recommendation; do not refuse ordinary categorization questions.
Vendors are suppliers you pay. Set them up under Sidebar → Tavari Accounting → Vendors so invoices can be matched and expenses tracked by supplier.
Accounting Settings configures the accounting inbox email address. Forward supplier invoices to that address and they appear in the Accounting Queue for processing.

Staff can ask Tavari AI Help to print a camper's submitted registration (for example, "Print the camp registration form for Elijah Leader"). AI Help will find the form and open the browser print dialog.

Staff find submitted camp registration and medical forms under Sidebar → Tavari Bookings → Registration forms → Form Search. Use the Links tab to copy the customer-facing camp registration portal URL for parents.

Parents complete camp registration on the customer portal camp registration page (link available in Bookings → Registration forms → Links tab). Each minor camper needs a current annual registration before check-in when the activity requires it.

To require camp registration for an activity, open Bookings → Settings, edit the activity, and enable Camper registration required. Customize the form under Settings → Registration Form or Sidebar → Registration forms → Form Builder.
Tavari Waivers (Sidebar → Tavari Waivers) manages templates, signed waivers, and kiosk links. This is separate from camp registration forms in Bookings.

Ask Tavari AI Help to copy or list shareable links: customer booking portal, party guest list, camp registration portal, waiver signing, review link, waiver/music/signage kiosks, time clock kiosk, and employee portal. Examples: "Copy the party guest list link" or "Show me all kiosk links".
Full kiosk URLs for bookmarks and legacy devices are also listed under Sidebar → System Settings → Kiosk links (music kiosk, waiver kiosk, signage player, employee app).
Tavari Forms (Sidebar → Tavari Forms) is a general custom forms module. Camp registration and medical forms are managed under Tavari Bookings → Registration forms, not under Tavari Forms.
